- Any outstanding security evidence we should start collecting (SOC2 scope, retention controls, encryption in transit/rest).

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: hosting mode + region decision and timeline

Alicia —

Appreciate the MAP and attachments. Quick summary up front: given your latency targets (sub-80ms token p95 for the trade-assist flow), and requirement to keep PII isolated, my recommendation is:

1) Short evaluation (3 weeks): use Hosted in a US-East region with an isolated project and strict retention rules. This gives fastest time-to-value and full observability for the perf runs.
2) If performance or data-isolation constraints require it after the eval, move to Dedicated (reserved GPUs in us-east) for predictable throughput.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) is only recommended if legal requires full customer-managed network or if you need an air-gapped deployment — that will add 6–8 weeks.

Proposed short timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Provision Hosted eval account + credentials, sign PO for eval access (minimal).
- Week 1: Integration + sample traffic (Marissa to assist with SDK + routing).
- Week 2: Performance runs and KV/prefix caching tests.
- Week 3: Security evidence review with Rishi; decision checkpoint and go/no-go.

I'll loop Marissa on integration tasks and Rishi on compliance items. If you agree, we will load the MAP spreadsheet with milestones and owners and share a HubSpot milestone.

Diego
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[signature: diego_fernandez | diego@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0192]

Alicia —

On the compliance front, quick checklist items to accelerate approval:
- We can provide SOC2 Type 2 report and architecture diagram for Hosted and Dedicated within 48 hours.
- For Private (VPC/on-prem) we need a legal/ops kickoff; evidence delivery will be on your cadence given customer's KMS/HSM controls.
- Retention controls: Hosted supports tenant-level retention policies; we can configure shorter token retention for evaluation.
- Data plane encryption: TLS in transit + AES-256 at rest (we can share certs and HSM integration notes).

Action items for Alicia: share the list of audit contacts and any required artifacts for procurement; we'll map owners in the MAP and attach timelines.

Rishi
